records.concept: Residency dossier and open visa gateway
records.brief: A dignified residency-document symbol: one partially open burgundy residency booklet, ivory page block, and a single sculpted antique-gold arched doorway recessed into the cover. A small plain gold corner tab evokes a visa document, without seals, flags, stars, stamps, checks or government emblems. The open doorway is integrated into the booklet, not separate buildings. Clear document silhouette at 48 pixels. Colors burgundy #502C43, ivory #F7EBD7, antique gold #C29A5C.
records.prompt: Create one exceptional mobile-app BRAND SYMBOL only, an original premium dimensional 3D-style pictogram, square canvas, isolated on a fully transparent RGBA background. No lettering, no wordmark, no numbers, no canvas tile, no checkerboard baked into artwork. Use clean confident geometry and a readily recognizable functional idea, not a busy illustration. Restrained tactile ceramic and fine metal materials, soft studio lighting, crisp clear silhouette, subtly front three-quarter view, broad surfaces and few parts. The symbol must fill about 72 percent of the square in its longest dimension, centered, with generous clear alpha margins and no ground-plane drop shadow or floating debris. Must read at small sizes and on white and dark backgrounds. Keep material detail subordinate to the silhouette. records.concept: A companion for an organized day
records.brief: A friendly sophisticated daily-planner symbol: a small warm-ivory calendar tile with two lavender binding tabs, three clearly separated peach and purple time blocks, and a compact purple clock dial integrated into its lower-right corner. The dial has only two clean hands, no numbers. The calendar and clock form one balanced silhouette; the open space between time blocks communicates breathing room. Colors violet #6D5B98, peach #F4A89D, ivory #F9EEE8. No heart, pebble, generic swirl or infinity symbol.

records.concept: Food surplus passed into caring hands
records.brief: A compact food-rescue and redistribution symbol: a deep terracotta-red food bowl with one stylized golden wheat sprig and a small green leaf emerging from it; two simplified warm-ivory cupped hand forms meet beneath the bowl from opposite sides, communicating sharing and transfer. Bowl, grain and hands form one deliberate coherent brand silhouette, not a still-life or fruit shopping icon. No tomato, badges, approval checks, arrows circle or delivery truck. Colors terracotta #A23E3C, harvest gold #F0BB52, cream #FCF3E4 and a restrained olive accent.
